author: Phoofi
body:
My Name is YSheep (formally known as Evan43210) , I am curious towards a particular topic , that being is there any open spots for an application ? I know its kinda blunt just asking it but its always been a happy thought in my mind and I thought that been a staff member would be kinda cool . I bet you'd figure this was just a gimmick to get the opportunity to become someone of importance just after joining , well thats not the truth . I actually joined about 2 and a half years ago and have been fairly active within the game . Though at times I have gotten into trouble . That being said I would like to re assure you that those punishments inflicted on me were from the first few months of me joining . Really to rap it up I would like to ask you again if there is anything that I could apply for , doesn't have to be fancy , just wanna be a part of the team . If you have anything for me , just reply and get back to me . Thanks for everything Avicus 

Also if you could , Post a reply on this discussion when spots are open .

Sincerely .. YSheep

title: Question About Staff Applications ..

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Hey there, Mirfah.


I would off like to apologise for the late response, different assignments pile us up and we sometimes forget about other work that needs to be done. Onto your question, Staff applications open once in awhile and that’s how a majority of staff members are chosen. We also have referral & handpicked systems which the staff team can vote on someone's acceptance for their promotion. I’m sorry that this reply is not during the application season, but one should be opening up soon!
